GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 5 lengths. got up fence turn 5 lengths. made late ground # Even Effort

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Ok off a tardy start at first run since early April. Better for it and can perform well second up.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , Settled touch Worse than midfield rails 5 Lengths 600m, Saved Ground staying back inside straightening, battled on well to get to Mid Field , tongue control bit off first time # battled on well
Jumped Ok worked over to lead 1000 metres. shared lead turn under pressure. weakened # poor
Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. gone turn. battled away # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted out and bumped. Was held up for clear running from the 400m until passing the 200m before being shifted abruptly to the outside of runner. App rdr was advised that in future when attempting to shift ground to obtain clear running he must refrain from doing so in such an abrupt manner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn. Held Ground # Not Sighted

Jumped Ok Went Forward from Outside Caught 6 Wide early Soon After Restrained Settled Down 9th 3 Wide with a trail 6 Lengths , Under Pressure Turning for home Just Kept Going One Pace Just Held Ground (t/t/off) - # 3 Wide 1-paced
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Dislodged its near-hind plate in the enclosure, became fractious behind the barriers and was unable to have the near-hind plate reapplied, therefore permission was granted for the off-hind plate to be removed and for the mare to race barefoot behind. Underwent a pre-race vet exam and was passed suitable to race. Near the 100m was brushed.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 8th Outside 7 Lengths following 1st x 1 Lengths let stride 3 Wide x 800 3 Wide 3rd x 600 1 Lengths Under Pressure 400 Just Kept Going One Pace - # early Wide move
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When the tempo reduced in the middle stages was steadied and shifted outwards near the 800m whereby it then raced wide and without cover from that point.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 4l off, battled on well, got going late # best work late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 200m when improving to the outside of rnr was inconvenienced and had to be shifted wider when that rnr shifted out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn. ran on well along fence. # Even Effort
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 lengths. got to outside turn 2 lengths. weakened # bled both nostrils
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over raced throughout the early and middle stages. Rider reported that her mount did not suit the slow tempo and did not appreciate the step up in distance. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the mare to have bled from both nostrils. Trainer was advised of the provisions under AR79.
